articles.title: China's New Solar Technology Beats Traditional Panels in World-First Test
articles.summary: Scientists in China have reached a major milestone in clean energy. A research team successfully operated a one-megawatt solar farm using a material called perovskite, which is much thinner than the silicon panels used in most solar systems today. In tests at an industrial scale, this perovskite farm produced more electricity than a comparable silicon system nearby. Researchers say their method is tough, straightforward, and ready for factories to produce in large quantities. This breakthrough could make solar energy cheaper and more widely available around the world, helping countries reduce their use of fossil fuels and fight climate change.

lv1: What special material was used in China's new solar farm? (中國新型太陽能農場使用了什麼特別的材料？)
How big was the solar farm used in this test? (這次測試所用的太陽能農場有多大規模？)
lv2: Why might perovskite solar panels be better than traditional silicon panels? (為什麼鈣鈦礦太陽能板可能比傳統矽太陽能板更好？)
How could this discovery help fight climate change around the world? (這項發現如何幫助全球對抗氣候變化？)
lv3: If perovskite solar technology becomes widely used, who would benefit most and who might be negatively affected? Consider energy companies, developing countries, and the environment. (如果鈣鈦礦太陽能技術得到廣泛應用，誰會最受益，誰可能受到負面影響？請考慮能源公司、發展中國家和環境。)
Some people argue that relying on one country to lead clean energy technology is risky for the rest of the world. Do you agree? Give reasons for your view. (有人認為依賴單一國家主導清潔能源技術對其他國家存在風險，你是否同意？請說明理由。)

articles.title: Hong Kong Plans Giant University Town in the North to Attract World Students
articles.summary: Hong Kong is developing a large new area in the Northern Metropolis that will include a dedicated university town. Supporters say that if the project is planned carefully, it could bring together students and researchers from around the world, creating fresh international links. The university town aims to redefine what higher education can look like in Hong Kong, potentially attracting top talent from overseas and strengthening the city's reputation as a global knowledge hub. However, commentators note that the project is also a major test of whether Hong Kong can truly compete with other leading education cities in Asia and beyond.

lv1: Where in Hong Kong is the new university town being built? (香港新大學城正在哪裡興建？)
What is the main goal of the Northern Metropolis University Town project? (北部都會區大學城計劃的主要目標是什麼？)
lv2: Why is it important for Hong Kong to attract students and researchers from other countries? (為什麼吸引來自其他國家的學生和研究人員對香港很重要？)
What challenges might Hong Kong face when trying to compete with other top education cities in Asia? (香港在嘗試與亞洲其他頂尖教育城市競爭時，可能面對哪些挑戰？)
lv3: Do you think building a large university town is the best way to improve Hong Kong's education system? What other approaches could the government consider? (你認為興建大型大學城是改善香港教育體系的最佳方式嗎？政府還可以考慮哪些其他方法？)

Some worry that a new university town might mostly benefit wealthy students or those from overseas, leaving local students behind. How should the government ensure the project is fair and inclusive? (有人擔心新大學城可能主要惠及富裕學生或海外生，令本地學生被忽視。政府應如何確保計劃公平共融？)

articles.title: 香港全年經濟增長預測上調 政府料AI貿易帶動消費
articles.summary: 香港政府最新上調全年本地生產總值增長預測，升幅介乎3.5%至4.5%。當局認為，人工智能相關產品的貿易持續活躍，加上本港消費市道具備韌性，是帶動經濟表現的主要原因。政府又預期，隨著AI產業在全球持續擴張，香港作為國際貿易及金融樞紐，將可把握更多發展機遇。經濟好轉的消息令市民感到鼓舞，但亦有學者提醒，香港仍需積極應對地緣政治帶來的不確定因素，以保持競爭優勢。

lv1: 香港政府將全年經濟增長預測調整到什麼範圍？
政府認為哪個行業是帶動香港經濟的主要原因？
lv2: 為什麼人工智能產品的貿易增長，能夠幫助香港整體經濟發展？
學者提醒香港需要注意什麼潛在風險？
lv3: 香港經濟增長主要依靠AI貿易，這是否一個可持續的發展策略？請從不同角度分析其利與弊。
如果香港要在AI時代保持競爭力，政府、學校和企業各自應該承擔什麼責任？

articles.title: 警方暑假打擊青少年罪行 新界南兩日拘16人最細僅13歲
articles.summary: 香港警方新界南總區於暑假期間展開連串執法行動，針對青少年犯罪問題。行動歷時兩日，共拘捕16人，其中11名為13至21歲的青少年，涉及在公眾地方行為不檢、管有攻擊性武器及危險藥物等罪行。警方亦就葵涌廣場早前發生的童黨滋擾食肆事件，再度拘捕兩名14至15歲的本地男中學生。行動期間，警員聯同不同部門巡查青少年常到的地點，並檢獲多種電子煙產品，總值約5,100元。

lv1: 警方今次行動在哪個地區展開？
行動中被捕的人士共有多少名？
lv2: 為什麼警方選擇在暑假期間特別加強針對青少年的執法行動？
電子煙對青少年有什麼潛在危害，為何警方要特別檢獲相關產品？
lv3: 單靠執法行動，能否有效解決青少年犯罪問題？社會各界（包括家庭、學校和政府）應如何合作，從根本上預防問題發生？
有意見認為，部分青少年走上犯罪道路，是因為缺乏支援和出路，你是否同意？社會應如何為他們提供更好的幫助？
